open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have sapp {α} {a b c d : List α} (h1 : a.Subset c) (h2 : b.Subset d) : (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) :=
    List.Subset.app (h1.trans (List.subset_append_left _ _)) (h2.trans (List.subset_append_right _ _))
  intro Hnorm
  induction Hnorm
  case const | bvar | fvar | op => exact List.Subset.empty
  case abs => assumption
  case quant trih eih => exact sapp trih eih
  case ite cih tih eih => exact sapp (sapp cih tih) eih
  case eq ih1 ih2 => exact sapp ih1 ih2
  case app fn e Hn fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
    · next Hfalse =>
      exfalso
      specialize Hn ⟨⟩
      cases Hn
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    · exact sapp fn_ih e_ih
